numeric_comparison_scope: All backend comparisons use corresponding full RM calls with the same forward batch shape. The image139 single-query vector is not asserted pointwise equal to its12-row-gallery vector; the stock cross-batch difference is retained separately.
forward_counter_scope: Ray native batch embed_calls records successful image_returns, not every possible internal attempt. Other complete probes retain attempts and returns. Successful CLI calls and no application reruns do not assert native internal retries are absolutely zero.
